text: Hi, welcome to the training room. Here is some important information that may be valuable.
You can buy heroes and towers on the right side of the screen. Each tower has upgrades that can be bought by left clicking on them.
Heroes will usually have an ability as well, which can be activated by right clicking them.
Heroes will also have a set amount of health. If any bloons leak without any heroes active, then you will lose.
You win by completing all of the waves in a mission. You can start the waves by pressing the spacebar. You can also send the next wave early with the spacebar.
You can also buy upgrades with the hot keys 'z', 'x', and 'c'. These correspond to the top to bottom upgrade paths.
Thanks for coming to the training room, have fun!
Rainbow Bloons contain a lot of bloons inside them.
Every 5th round will be particularly hard, with elevated bloon types, so stay alert.
A boss is spawning, use it for target practice.
When bloons reach the end of the track, they do a set amount of damage and then loop back around to the start of the track.
Mini MOABs require 50 hits to pop. Then they drop 4 rainbow bloons!

Shielded Bloons have a high density barrier that absorbs extra damage. 
Density 10: Shields absorb as much pierce as hitting 10 bloons.

Lead bloons are metallic. They resist sharp projectiles and can be damaged by explosions and other types of damage. 
Metallic: Can only be damaged by certain projectiles.
Ceramic Bloons take 10 hits to pop. Then they drop 2 rainbow bloons.

Block bloons are metallic and require 15 hits to pop. They drop 4 leads. 
Metallic: Can only be damaged by certain projectiles.
Bricks take 30 hits to pop and drop 2 ceramics.
Moabs take 200 hits to pop and drop 4 ceramics.
